name: tugite
description: Use whats-this for explicit Interactive requested-output workflows, explorer-this for explicit exploration, and impl-lead, plan-agent, plan-interactive, review-refine, code-review, and test-report with internal skills, Implementation Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors while the parent Codex agent owns planning, QA, and final verification.

interface.shortDescription: Install agents and delegate with parent QA.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for the public workflows whats-this, explorer-this, impl-lead, plan-agent, plan-interactive, review-refine, code-review, and test-report, their internal skills, Implementation Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors. Whats-this and explorer-this are explicit-only, keep one task-local Local Model, and connect directly to requested output; whats-this uses Interactive Model Construction while explorer-this qualified-stops on unresolved material gaps. Code-review also applies when a user clearly wants a Tugite code-review of a change set, and reports evidence-checked findings without fixing or adjudicating. Test-report also applies when a user clearly wants to understand a specified set of tests, and observes them as a Verification Topology without editing, running, or evaluating tests. The parent Codex agent performs parent QA and keeps final quality responsibility.
defaultPrompt: Use $whats-this only for an explicit public workflow; keep one task-local Local Model, use Interactive Model Construction, and connect directly to the requested output.
Use $explorer-this only for explicit public exploration requests; keep one task-local Local Model, connect directly to the requested output, and qualified-stop on unresolved material gaps.

Use $test-report when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants to understand a specified set of tests; observe them as a Verification Topology and report observed gaps without editing, running, or evaluating tests.
Use $plan-agent to draft or refine a free-form planning artifact without starting implementation.
Use $plan-interactive to draft a human-directed planning artifact through mandatory common synthesis, gate, and bounded review without starting implementation.
Use $review-refine to review an immutable artifact snapshot with bounded rounds and caller-owned acceptance evidence.

Use $code-review when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants a Tugite code-review of a change set; capture an immutable snapshot, route specialist reviewers, and report evidence-checked findings without fixing, adjudicating, or writing to the review target. Do not start during impl-lead or plan-family public workflows.
Use $impl-lead to run bounded Implementation Unit implementation loops with parent QA.
Use $install-custom-agents to check, install, or update the bundled custom agents.
